Journalist Ravi Nair Granted Bail in Gujarat Defamation Case

The Gujarat High Court granted bail to journalist Ravi Nair in a defamation case filed by the Adani group. The court reserved its verdict and ordered Nair to remain in custody until September 30. In a related political statement, Rahul Gandhi urged the Chief Election Commissioner to become an approver. These developments were reported by multiple Indian outlets.
